subject: Onboarding sprint: console + API enablement
messages:
From: Jordan Mathews <jordan@orbithealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tanya Singh <tanya@orbithealth.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Onboarding sprint: console + API enablement

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. We'd like to move forward with a short onboarding sprint to get console familiarity and an API enablement lab scheduled for our platform engineers. High-level asks:
- Console walkthrough (45m) focused on routes, model pinning, and rollouts
- API enablement lab (90m) with token usage, batching, and sample evals
- Security touchpoint: quick walkthrough of audit logs and key rotation

We have a small group (4 people): myself (product), Tanya (platform), Arjun (SRE), and Priya (InfoSec). Proposed windows next week (all ET):
- Tue 10/5 10:00–12:00
- Wed 10/6 15:00–17:00
- Thu 10/7 09:00–11:00

Attached is the attendee list and role mapping. Can you confirm which slot works and whether we should split the sessions across two days? Also please confirm we can get sandbox keys in advance for the lab.

Thanks,
Jordan

Attachments: orbit_attendee_list.csv (CSV, 1KB)
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Mathews <jordan@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 29 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint: console + API enablement

Jordan — great to hear. We can run a compact two-part sprint: 45m console overview + 90m hands-on API lab. Quick notes and asks from our side:
- Preferred plan: split across two blocks (console day, lab day) to reduce context switching for your SREs and InfoSec.
- Can do Tue 10/5 10:00–11:00 (console) and Thu 10/7 09:00–10:30 (lab) — if that fits your team.
- We'll need 1 engineer with access to your sandbox to join the lab for deployment checks, or we can provide temporary test creds.
- Please confirm whether SSO is required for the console demo (we can mock SSO flows but would need time to provision SAML assertions if you want to test end-to-end).

Marissa, Camila — looping you in to book the invites and prep a short runbook (I can own the console segment; Camila can lead the lab).

If any of the proposed times are tight, tell us which is best and we'll pivot.

Best,
Rishi

---
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183
From: Jordan Mathews <jordan@orbithealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tanya Singh <tanya@orbithealth.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint: console + API enablement

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the split suggestion. Quick update: exec review bumped our team on Tue morning; we need to move the console overview to the afternoon or shift both items by a day. New proposed windows (ET):
- Wed 10/6 14:00–15:00 (console) + Fri 10/8 09:00–10:30 (lab)
- OR Thu 10/7 13:00–14:00 (console) + Thu 10/7 16:00–17:30 (lab) — same day, split by a short break if you can accommodate.

SSO: InfoSec would like to see a high-level SAML flow but doesn't need full E2E in the first run; sandbox test creds will be fine for the lab. We will confirm who will be the sandbox-access engineer by EOD Friday.

Would prefer the split across two days if possible so we can incorporate security review learnings between sessions. Also can you share a 1-page preflight checklist we can run on our side?

Thanks,
Jordan

Date: Fri, 01 Oct 2027 16:42:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding sprint: console + API enablement

Jordan — thanks for the update. We can accommodate the split across two days; booking the Wed/Fri cadence per your preference is fine. Confirmed schedule below (calendar invites attached):

1) Console overview (45m) — Wed, 6 Oct 2027 — 14:00–14:45 ET
   - Owner: Rishi (console walkthrough, routes/rollouts, model pinning)
   - Prep: Please ensure one engineer can join with sandbox access; if not, we'll provide temporary test creds 24h before the lab.

2) API enablement lab (90m) — Fri, 8 Oct 2027 — 09:00–10:30 ET
   - Owner: Camila (hands-on lab: tokens, batching, KV cache patterns)
   - Prep: We'll share a short preflight checklist and a small test repo.

Attachments included: redwood_onboard_runbook_v1.pdf (runbook + checklist), calendar_invite_orbit_onboard.ics

If anything changes on your side, ping me directly and we'll rework. Looking forward to it.

Best regards,
Marissa
